from.place: ## Proof, first sentence: the proper curve C must first be shown projective, using the dimension-one quasi-projectivity input; via Stacks 09NZ, proof, third sentence: 'by Lemma 09NY there exists an invertible O_X-module L on X whose restriction to Z is ample'

title: Invertible modules lift along a closed immersion into a Noetherian space of dimension at most one
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is Noetherian (every nonempty set of closed subsets of $X$ has a minimal element for inclusion) and has Krull dimension $\dim X\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then for every invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal N$ [def-sc-invertible-module] there exists an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ with $i^*\mathcal L\cong\mathcal N$ as $\mathcal O_Z$-modules, $i^*$ the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback]; that is, $\operatorname{Pic}(X)\to\operatorname{Pic}(Z)$ is surjective.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 09NY (varieties-lemma-lift-line-bundle-from-reduction-dimension-1, line 8138); its proof uses Cohomology Proposition 02UZ (cohomology-proposition-vanishing-Noetherian), Cohomology Lemma 02UV (cohomology-lemma-cohomology-and-closed-immersions) and Cohomology Lemma 09NU (cohomology-lemma-h1-invertible)

proof.text: The units restriction f is epi by lem-sc-closed-immersion-zariski-units-epi. Its categorical kernel K gives the short exact sequence K -> O_X^times -> i_* O_Z^times. This is precisely the kernel (1+I) intersect O_X^times from the source, without choosing ideal-sheaf data.

Apply lem-sc-noetherian-cohomology-vanishing-abelian-dim-one to K. Identify H-prime at the top open with H by sheafifying the canonical isomorphism from the free abelian presheaf on the terminal representable to the constant integer presheaf. This gives H^2(X,K)=0. Exactness at H^1(X,i_*O_Z^times) in the kernel sequence therefore makes H^1(f) surjective.

The specific canonical comparison to H^1(Z,O_Z^times) is bijective by lem-sc-closed-immersion-units-cohomology-comparison-bijective. Lift the class of N through this comparison, then through the H^1 surjection from step 2.

The Hilbert-90 equivalence thm-sc-hilbert-90 supplies a Picard class on X representing the lifted H^1 class. Choose its invertible representative L. Lem-sc-picard-h1-restriction-compatibility identifies the compared restriction class with the class of tensorPullback(i,L), and supplies invertibility of this pullback. Injectivity of the Hilbert-90 equivalence gives equality of Picard classes, hence an isomorphism tensorPullback(i,L) with N.
